title: SEC Adds Tokenization to Fiscal 2027 Examination Priorities
why_it_matters: Tokenization is moving from a policy experiment into the SEC's recurring supervisory work, raising the compliance stakes for market infrastructure that records, clears or operates tokenized securities.
caption:
RWA WIRE // REGULATION

SEC Adds Tokenization to Fiscal 2027 Examination Priorities

The SEC's Division of Examinations will scrutinize tokenization at clearing agencies and Regulation SCI entities as part of its risk-based fiscal 2027 program.
